Regional distribution. Iran (no locality cited) (Wittmer 1994). General distribution. Endemic species for Iranian fauna.

Distribution in South America: Pacific Ocean, Chile, at 33 ºS off Valparaíso (Ulloa et al. 2000); Atlantic Ocean, Brazil, from 0 º to 33 ºS (Totton 1941; Alvariño 1971; Dias 1994; Pugh 1999; Migotto et al. 2002; Silveira & Morandini 2011; Nishiyama 2016; Nishiyama et al. 2016). Habitat: neritic and oceanic species, mesopelagic, found in tropical, subtropical and temperate waters (Pugh 1999; Pugh & Gasca 2009; Nishiyama 2016).
